end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying 3D shapes using familiar toys and objects, including a dice, rolling pin, candle, party cap and ball. Aditya connected a wheel with a cylinder and described why a sphere has no flat face. They first mixed up a cone’s name when it was turned, but corrected this later by recognising the party cap as a cone in either direction. At home, ask Aditya to find one example of each shape and describe its flat and curved faces.
